locator.printed: p. 218, final greeting, dismissal and response

entries.claim: The source prints the complete 15-word final greeting, doubled-Alleluia dismissal and response. The sung dismissal rubric expressly permits the deacon or the priest; it does not establish one sole performer.
Double Alleluia belongs to the Vigil and to Masses De Tempore within the Easter octave through Saturday, not Low Sunday or a coincident sanctoral Mass.
